explanation: German has nominative, accusative, dative and genitive. Finnish adds cases for in, into, out of, on and more, so 'in the house' is one word, talossa.

claims.text: Finnish nouns have 15 grammatical cases in the standard count.
German has four grammatical cases: nominative, accusative, dative and genitive.
Finnish talossa, 'in the house', is a single word in the inessive case.
